jobDescription:
AI Engineer, New Grad — Applied AI

We build products on top of large language models: retrieval systems over messy
private corpora, agent harnesses that call real tools, and the evaluation
infrastructure that keeps both honest.

What you'll do
- Design and ship retrieval-augmented pipelines over domain corpora
- Build agentic workflows: tool use, planning loops, structured outputs
- Write evals. We care more about a candidate who has measured a model's
  output than one who has prompted it well
- Own a feature end to end, from the prompt to the interface

What we look for
- Strong Python; comfort in TypeScript for the product surface
- Hands-on experience with an LLM API in something real, not a tutorial
- Any experience with RAG, vector search, fine-tuning, or eval harnesses
- Evidence you can reason about model failure modes, not just model successes
- BS in CS or equivalent; research experience welcome but not required

Nice to have: MCP, LangGraph, distributed training, prior open-source work.
